needs_atom.missing: Clause 'Whenever this creature attacks, it deals 1 damage to the player or planeswalker it's attacking.': no Selector, referent or filter predicate names the object a creature is attacking (CR 506.2, 508.1b). The executor's attack record (Executor.attacked) is readable only through DeclareAttackersEvent.attacked and ATTACK_AGAINST_COUNT_GE, and an attack firing binds only the 'declare_attackers' register (the attackers). Missing: e.g. a Selector referent 'attacked' (the player or the planeswalker the source attacks, kept if it leaves combat) usable as DEAL_DAMAGE's target. Rejected approximations: ControllerRef.DEFENDING_PLAYER (7a598df) names the defending player, so the damage would hit the player when the Spitter attacks a planeswalker; 'each opponent' (the same, and every opponent in multiplayer); 'target player or planeswalker' (adds a free choice).
